data.body:
[P2] Retain cleanup diagnostics on the recorded delivery fatal

If output serialization throws an `InternalError` after the handler returns successfully, `getInvocationFatal()` is already set, so this branch skips the completed fatal. `finishActualInvocationCleanup()` returns a `CompletionException` wrapping that fatal from checkpoint-batcher shutdown. If owned `shutdown()` then throws an ordinary exception, its diagnostic is attached to that wrapper. `DurableExecutor.execute()` throws the raw completed fatal before inspecting `finalFailure`, losing the shutdown diagnostic. Aggregate owned cleanup failures onto the recorded fatal while preserving wrapper diagnostics without creating a cause/suppression cycle. Add a regression covering fatal serialization followed by ordinary shutdown failure.
